hook.text: Without suspension, driving over a small bump at speed would launch you out of your seat.

buildup.text: Suspension uses springs to absorb bumps and dampers (shock absorbers) to control the bounce.

discovery.text: Springs store energy when compressed. Dampers convert that energy into heat so the car settles fast.

twist.text: Soft suspension gives comfort but the car leans in corners. Stiff suspension handles well but rides rough.

climax.text: Adaptive dampers adjust firmness on the fly—soft on highways, stiff on twisty roads.

punchline.text: Suspension is the compromise between comfort and control.
